description: This file defines the class `GeneralRuntimeException`, a custom runtime exception in Java that supports nested exceptions and multiple ways to instantiate and print exception details.

classes.name: GeneralRuntimeException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class that extends `RuntimeException` and adds support for nested exceptions, custom message formatting, and enhanced stack trace printing.

methods.name: GeneralRuntimeException()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an exception without a message or nested exception.

methods.name: GeneralRuntimeException(String msg)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a detailed message describing the exception.

methods.name: GeneralRuntimeException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a nested exception without an additional message.

methods.name: GeneralRuntimeException(String msg, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts both a detail message and a nested exception.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Returns the exception message, including the nested exception's message if present.

methods.name: getNonNestedMessage()
methods.description: Returns only the message of this exception, excluding nested exception messages.

methods.name: getNested()
methods.description: Returns the nested exception, or null if none exists.

methods.name: printStackTrace()
methods.description: Prints the stack trace for this exception and any nested exception to System.err.

methods.name: printStackTrace(PrintStream ps)
methods.description: Prints the stack trace to a specified PrintStream, including nested exceptions if present.

methods.name: printStackTrace(PrintWriter pw)
methods.description: Prints the stack trace to a specified PrintWriter, including nested exceptions if present.
